description_en: Deletes custom frequency control rules of a website
description_zh: 删除网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
name: DeleteWebCCRuleV2

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The names of the rules that you want to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的规则的名称列表
parameters.name: rule_names

parameters.help_en:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

manual (default): manually created.

clover: automatically created. Specify this value when you want to delete intelligent protection rules
parameters.help_zh:
规则来源。取值：
manual：手动添加（默认）
clover：自动生成（指定删除智能规则使用）
parameters.name: owner

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
